# tf-plan-summary

> Summarize terraform show -json plans by risk: replace and delete detection, protected resource rules, attribute names without values, Markdown or JSON Go module `github.com/Trysac/u181-tf-plan-summary`, package `tfplansummary`, MIT licensed,
> Go >= 1.23, standard library only.
